description: Transparency is the foundation of public trust, and the American people deserve leaders who are honest about where their money comes from and whose interests they serve. That is why this transparency page exists. Voters should not have to guess who is funding a candidate, how that candidate earns income, or whether personal financial interests may influence public decisions. Those seeking to represent the public should not hide behind secrecy when trust must be earned.
